name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 11.5%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Apply the declared insured salary grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar; round each share once after day proration. Variable wages use an independently recorded three-month-average declaration. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007758.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html Applied 2026-09-23: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 — the government subsidises the insured worker's own share by the certificate's severity (100/50/25%); BLI computes the subsidy on the worker's unrounded share and rounds it to the whole dollar on its own, and the worker is withheld the rounded share less the rounded subsidy — BLI's worked example (勞動部勞工保險局納保組 許晉慶, 〈身心障礙勞工保險費減免〉, 台灣勞工季刊 第44期 p.72–73, https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/q5cjfwu3/%E6%B4%BB%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%A6%8F.pdf): 輕度, grade 28,800, LI 9%: (28,800×9%×20%) − (28,800×9%×20%×25%) = 518 − 130 = 388; EI 1%: 58 − 14 = 44. Subsidy standards 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090). The employer share is unchanged.

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

name: 積欠工資墊償基金 (wage arrears payment fund)
authority: Labor Standards Act article 28. Sum all covered workers’ prorated LI-equivalent insured salaries, including workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance, then apply 0.025% and round once to the nearest whole dollar at company level. Source: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0110180.html

name: Employment Insurance (就業保險)

name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. Applied 2026-09-23: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090) — the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of a disabled person's own premium; 全民健康保險法 §27(1)(1) makes each dependant's 30% their own (被保險人及其眷屬自付), so each disabled dependant's per-person premium is subsidised on its own (elections `disability_subsidy`, `dependants_subsidised_*`). 全民健康保險法施行細則 §52: premiums are paid in whole dollars, 角以下四捨五入, and where the self-paid premium and the government subsidy both end in five 角 the subsidy rounds up (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=L0060002) — so each person's subsidy is round_unit(per-person premium × share) and the worker pays the rest. The supplementary premium is outside the subsidy (臺北市政府社會局, citing 衛生福利部). Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/en/cp-68-8652 f-35-2.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4516-74 b 0 f-2613-1.html

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)

Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

A worker insured through this unit (`facts.NHI.registered`) is outside this premium; their bonus premium is NHI_SUPPLEMENT. Each payslip is one payment (PAY_PERIOD). name: Labor Pension (勞工退休金, new system)
authority: Labor Pension Act articles 7, 14, 15 and 18. The employer contributes at least 6% of the declared monthly contribution wage. An employee may voluntarily contribute up to 6%; the default is no voluntary contribution. Apply the declared grade and covered days on a thirty-day month, rounding after proration. A February departure on the last day completes thirty contribution days. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0017599.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm

name: Occupational Accident Insurance (勞工職業災害保險)

Round the resulting premium once to whole NT dollars after day proration. The declared grade is effective independently of contract wage changes. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0106129.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm An insured unit on an experience-rated industry rate (勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §16(4), 實績費率: the Bureau notifies the unit’s own rate each year) records the notified total rate, commuting rate included, as the registration’s rate override; otherwise the industry table rate applies.

name: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 114年度 table (台財稅字第11304679670號函): NT$97,000 personal exemption, NT$262,000 married standard deduction and NT$218,000 salary deduction. name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 11.5%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Apply the declared insured salary grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar; round each share once after day proration. Variable wages use an independently recorded three-month-average declaration. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007758.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html Applied 2026-09-23: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 — the government subsidises the insured worker's own share by the certificate's severity (100/50/25%); BLI computes the subsidy on the worker's unrounded share and rounds it to the whole dollar on its own, and the worker is withheld the rounded share less the rounded subsidy — BLI's worked example (勞動部勞工保險局納保組 許晉慶, 〈身心障礙勞工保險費減免〉, 台灣勞工季刊 第44期 p.72–73, https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/q5cjfwu3/%E6%B4%BB%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%A6%8F.pdf): 輕度, grade 28,800, LI 9%: (28,800×9%×20%) − (28,800×9%×20%×25%) = 518 − 130 = 388; EI 1%: 58 − 14 = 44. elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. authority: Labor Standards Act article 28. name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. elections.label: Disability premium subsidy — insured (%)
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73; 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5; 全民健康保險法 §27 (the insured and each dependant pay their own 30%): the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of the insured person's own per-person premium. Record the percentage on the insured's disability certificate; zero when none. The supplementary premium is not subsidised.

elections.label: Dependants with 極重度/重度 disability
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73; 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5; 全民健康保險法 §27 (the insured and each dependant pay their own 30%): of the dependants charged (at most three), how many hold a 極重度 or 重度 certificate — their per-person premium is paid in full by the government.

elections.label: Dependants with 中度 disability
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73; 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5; 全民健康保險法 §27 (the insured and each dependant pay their own 30%): of the dependants charged (at most three), how many hold a 中度 certificate — half of each one's per-person premium is subsidised.

elections.label: Dependants with 輕度 disability
elections.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73; 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5; 全民健康保險法 §27 (the insured and each dependant pay their own 30%): of the dependants charged (at most three), how many hold a 輕度 certificate — a quarter of each one's per-person premium is subsidised.

elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

name: 健保補充保險費 (NHI supplementary premium)

After departure, retain the insured amount at withdrawal. The regular month-end premium being zero does not remove this threshold. Round once to whole NT dollars. name: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 115年度 table (台財稅字第11404675280號函): NT$101,000 personal exemption, NT$272,000 married standard deduction and NT$227,000 salary deduction. Published salary bands truncate table tax to NT$10; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse/dependant exemptions use the annualised formula in explanation (3), truncated to NT$1. Current-month voluntary labour pension contributions are excluded once under 勞工退休金條例 article 14(4). Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). Tax residency must be declared on dated employment terms; citizenship does not determine residence. https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/tax-info/understanding/tax-q-and-a/national/individual-income-tax/withheld-rule/rule/NM11BZY Applied 2026-09-23 (engine audit): a bonus class counts toward INCOME_TAX_BONUS instead of this scheme, so the regular base carries no bonus to subtract.

rules.refusal: Record tax residency as resident or non-resident on the employment terms before calculating Taiwan withholding.

elections.label: Elect 5% withholding
elections.description: 薪資所得扣繳辦法 §6: a resident's regular salary is withheld at 5% where no withholding declaration (免稅額申報表) is on file, and on the worker's own election even with one. Unrecorded is no election: the declaration, where recorded, selects the table.

elections.description: The reference of the worker's filed withholding declaration (免稅額申報表), which selects the 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 (薪資所得扣繳辦法 §6–7). Unrecorded, there is no declaration and §6's 5% applies.

authority: 所得稅法 article 88 and 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 3(2): non-resident salary, including taxable allowances and bonuses, is assessed monthly at 6% when total monthly salary does not exceed 1.5 times the applicable minimum wage; otherwise 18%. name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: Labor Insurance Act articles 6, 8, 9, 13–15; Enforcement Rules articles 27, 28-1 and 33. Ordinary-risk premium rate 12%, shared 20% employee, 70% employer and 10% government. Registered continuing cover remains chargeable after age 65. Apply the declared insured salary grade and covered days on a thirty-day calendar; round each share once after day proration. Variable wages use an independently recorded three-month-average declaration. Salary changes do not automatically change the insured grade; notified adjustments take effect on the first of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0007758.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0014162.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html Applied 2026-09-23: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 — the government subsidises the insured worker's own share by the certificate's severity (100/50/25%); BLI computes the subsidy on the worker's unrounded share and rounds it to the whole dollar on its own, and the worker is withheld the rounded share less the rounded subsidy — BLI's worked example (勞動部勞工保險局納保組 許晉慶, 〈身心障礙勞工保險費減免〉, 台灣勞工季刊 第44期 p.72–73, https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/q5cjfwu3/%E6%B4%BB%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E8%A6%8F.pdf): 輕度, grade 28,800, LI 9%: (28,800×9%×20%) − (28,800×9%×20%×25%) = 518 − 130 = 388; EI 1%: 58 − 14 = 44. elections.label: 育嬰留職停薪續保 (parental-leave continuation)
elections.description: 性別平等工作法 §16(2): 受僱者於育嬰留職停薪期間，得繼續參加原有之社會保險，原由雇主負擔之保險費，免予繳納；原由受僱者負擔之保險費，得遞延三年繳納. Record it on the declaration dated for the 育嬰留職停薪 period when the worker applied to continue (育嬰留職停薪實施辦法 §2(2)(5)): CONTINUED, or DEFERRED where the worker chose to pay their own share up to three years later. Either way payroll charges nothing for those days: the employer's share is not payable (the government bears it, BLI FAQ https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006915.html), and the insurer bills the worker's own share to the worker directly (勞保局: 寄出…育嬰續保保險費繳款單予被保險人繳納, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/20250/; 健保署: 繳款單由健保署寄發被保險人). NONE, the default, is no continuation: continuation is only on the worker's application (§16(2) 得繼續參加; 實施辦法 §2(2)(5)), so a worker not on the leave, or one who did not apply, is NONE.

authority: Labor Standards Act article 28. name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: National Health Insurance Act articles 18, 27, 29 and 30; Enforcement Rules article 52. Regular premiums use the declared insured amount at the month-end insuring unit. The employee pays 30% of the 5.17% premium for self and up to three enrolled dependants; published whole-dollar per-person premiums apply. The employer pays 60% with the published 1.56 average dependant factor. The declaration is independent of contract salary and retains its effective dates. Applied 2026-09-23: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73 and 身心障礙者參加社會保險保險費補助辦法 §4–5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?PCode=D0050090) — the government pays 100% (極重度/重度), 50% (中度) or 25% (輕度) of a disabled person's own premium; 全民健康保險法 §27(1)(1) makes each dependant's 30% their own (被保險人及其眷屬自付), so each disabled dependant's per-person premium is subsidised on its own (elections `disability_subsidy`, `dependants_subsidised_*`). 全民健康保險法施行細則 §52: premiums are paid in whole dollars, 角以下四捨五入, and where the self-paid premium and the government subsidy both end in five 角 the subsidy rounds up (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=L0060002) — so each person's subsidy is round_unit(per-person premium × share) and the worker pays the rest. The supplementary premium is outside the subsidy (臺北市政府社會局, citing 衛生福利部). Sources: https://www.nhi.gov.tw/en/cp-68-8652 f-35-2.html ; https://www.nhi.gov.tw/ch/cp-4516-74 b 0 f-2613-1.html

name: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 article 88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 article 2; 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7. Resident regular salary is assessed on the full month's payments, separately from non-monthly bonus payments. The table method requires a dated declaration reference and the declared spouse/dependant count. Family records do not grant table exemptions. Without the declaration, article 6 requires 5%; an explicit 5% election also uses that method. The 5% method truncates tax to whole NT dollars before applying the NT$2,000 exemption; NT$40,020 is the first whole-dollar salary requiring withholding. The table method uses the 115年度 table (台財稅字第11404675280號函): NT$101,000 personal exemption, NT$272,000 married standard deduction and NT$227,000 salary deduction. Published salary bands truncate table tax to NT$10; salaries above NT$500,000 or more than eleven spouse/dependant exemptions use the annualised formula in explanation (3), truncated to NT$1. Current-month voluntary labour pension contributions are excluded once under 勞工退休金條例 article 14(4). Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). rules.refusal: Record tax residency as resident or non-resident on the employment terms before calculating Taiwan withholding.

From 1 April 2026 a blue-collar migrant worker (WORK_PERMIT) with under ten years at the unit is left out of the 薪資總額 (勞動部 114年10月14日勞動福3字第1140153402A號令; https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/28690/2282/2302/86592/86636/post). An employer cost on that worker’s payslip, paid into the Bank of Taiwan account.
assessed_on: (has(person.facts.LABOR_PENSION) && !person.facts.LABOR_PENSION.registered && (person.employee.citizenship == "FOREIGNER" ? !(person.terms.pass_type == "WORK_PERMIT" && person.employment.service_months < 120 && period.key >= "2026-04") : person.employment.service_start < "2005-07-01")) ? (BASE + OVERTIME + (ALLOWANCES + ADHOC) + ENCASHMENT - ABSENCE - NO_PAY_LEAVE) : 0.0

rules.refusal: 勞動基準法 §56(1) with 勞工退休金條例 §7: whether a worker outside the new pension system is on the old system's reserve turns on nationality and, for a foreign worker, the pass. Record the residency status, and a foreign worker's pass type, on the employment terms before calculating payroll.

勞動基準法 §56(1): this entity has a worker on the old (LSA) pension system, so it owes the monthly 勞工退休準備金 at the rate the authority approved, 2–15% of the month's wages. Record it as the entity fact pension_reserve_rate before calculation.

name: Income tax — bonus withholding
authority: 薪資所得扣繳辦法 articles 6–7: non-monthly resident salary payments are withheld separately at 5% when the payment reaches the applicable no-dependant salary-table threshold. Smaller payments are exempt. Tax fractions below NT$1 are discarded under 各級公庫代理銀行代辦機構及代收稅款機構稅款解繳作業辦法 article 5 (https://law-out.mof.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=FL051526). Tax residency must be declared on dated employment terms; citizenship does not determine residence. https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw/etwmain/tax-info/understanding/tax-q-and-a/national/individual-income-tax/withheld-rule/rule/NM11BZY Applied 2026-09-23 (engine audit): the bonus is every class counting toward this scheme, never a company's code.

rules.refusal: Record tax residency as resident or non-resident on the employment terms before calculating Taiwan withholding.

name: Severance withholding (退職所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法 §14(1)(9) and §88; 各類所得扣繳率標準 §2: 資遣費 is 退職所得, withheld at the source on the excess over the 定額免稅 — 6% for a resident, 18% for a non-resident. 民國114年年度 (台財稅字第11204674210號公告): a lump sum is exempt to 198,000 × 退職服務年資, half taxable to 398,000 × 年資, whole above it; a 年資 tail of under six months counts as half a year, six months or more as one year (高雄國稅局). The employee declares the amount in the annual return, so this is the withholding only.

name: Wage arrears fund — covered wages
authority: Labor Standards Act article 28 and BLI wage arrears fund calculation guidance. Covered wages use each worker’s LI-equivalent insured salary, prorated for covered days on a thirty-day calendar. Workers covered only by employment or occupational accident insurance remain included. This assessment records the wage basis; the company fund scheme calculates and rounds the levy once. Source: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0110180.html Insured amounts must be declared separately from contractual wages; changing contract pay does not change the registered grade. Insurance declarations use the insurer-confirmed effective interval. BLI notices generally take effect on the first day of the following month. Sources: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0005472.htm ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0006928.html

rules.refusal: The declared insured amount is not a grade in force for this covered period. Record the insurer-confirmed adjustment.
The declared insured grade is below the full-time minimum. Correct the insurance declaration or employment profile.

elections.label: Wage arrears contribution wage
elections.description: Enter the insurer-confirmed monthly grade. The registration dates are its effective dates, not the salary-change or notification dates. A change takes effect from the first of the month after the insurer is notified (勞工保險條例 §14(2); 就業保險法 §40; 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17(3); 勞工退休金條例 §15(2): 自通知之次月一日生效), so a declaration changing it inside continuous cover is refused.
